[opaque block] Google Vault - Update on MDM related DRI efforts
of USAID staff, IPs and some experts. We will host one in January, and then make plans for others in the
Winter/Spring. Encompass and GROWTH will be helping us plan and facilitate. The learnings from these will help us
set up a larger MDM Learning / Evidence Summit or Conference for summer/ fall of 2023 -- date TBD. It will be for
after the S4D. The big hope from the small MDM learning retreats and the Conference is to really go deep on what's
working and what's not in the MDM programming space and to start assembling a picture of evidence, insights and a
learning agenda. We hope to use the retreats to do a lot of listening, gathering of data and insights and to help
inform our understanding of the bigger picture, the "so what" and what do all component parts add up to. We also
hope that we can start getting a sense of what difference the MDM programs are making and what type of data,
learning and insights can be assembled for us to share with others at USAID and a broader set of actors. We will
share more information on this asap.
3) We are continuing on with the stocktaking exercise related to programming of MDM:
The foundation of this work is assembled here -- see spreadsheet on (SBU) Disinformation Activity Data Sheet. We'll
be updating this -- some of you have already shared that you will help us... thank you!
A different rendering of some of this information is here at SBU - MDM Programming Placemat -- this gives an easy
to read/ at a glance of the 50+ programs that we have started to compile information on, with theories of change. We
want to keep adding to this list. So if you have any programming that's not on this list and should be, please let us
know.
As a next step on the stocktaking, we are hoping to work with the EL group -- through Matt Baker -- on doing an
assessment of evidence and learning around MDM programming -- from DRG funded programs and also Health.
The goal is to have a more grounded sense of what's working/ what's not working and why. We are hoping to
commission an assessment of any research, baseline data collection, midterm evaluations, final evaluations, etc.
from the programs outlined in the Disinformation Activity Data Sheet noted above. The goal is to do a deep dive
around already completed evidence and learning and to synthesize this information in a way that we can draw on it
and look at patterns, trends and key findings. We will supplement the document review deep dive with a number of
key informant interviews with implementing partners and local experts working on these programs. This tasking for
this assessment is still being finalized -- so will keep you in the loop. Here's a link to the DRAFT Tasker if you'd like
to weigh in and help us shape it. Please send comments by 16 December. DRAFT Tasker on MDM Program EL
Assessment -- please review and send your comments/ edits/ suggestions.
Susan Abbott
Information Resilience &Tech Advisor
Democratic Resilience and Innovation Team
Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
US Agency for International Development
